summary: @servicetitan/form-state 41.3.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs uses obfuscated `_0xNNNN` variable naming, fingerprints the host (probes `ldd --version` and reads `/etc/os-release` to detect musl/Alpine), downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and runs the sibling `math_init.js` under that Bun binary via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with a string-array-shuffle routine and randomized identifiers; the `math_init` filename does not correspond to any functionality of a React/mobx form-state helper. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based scanners and executes attacker-controlled bundled code on every install of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
